about.text: I design and build websites for small and growing businesses: **clinics, salons, IT companies, restaurants and service brands.** For 6 years I've been doing both design and development, so the site you approve in Figma is exactly the site that goes live.
about.name: Andrew Deleniv
about.soloText: You talk directly to the person who designs and builds your site. No account managers, no hand-offs between teams, no details lost on the way. One person, one process, full responsibility.

faq.lead: Everything about price, timing and what happens after launch.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the features, the number of sections and pages, and other details. **A simple website starts from €300.** Describe your project, and I'll send you an exact quote.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A landing page takes **2–3 weeks**, a corporate website **4–8 weeks**, and an online store **6+ weeks**. The timeline also depends on how quickly you send content and feedback.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Work starts after a **50% prepayment** of the total price. The remaining 50% is paid once all work is finished.

items.question: Are there any extra costs besides development?
items.answer: Yes. If you don't have them yet, the **domain and hosting** are paid separately. I'll tell you the exact amount in advance and add it to the total. This is a **yearly payment**.

items.question: Will the website be fully mine?
items.answer: Yes. After launch you get the **domain, hosting and all access**. The only exception: if the website stays on my hosting, access to the hosting account itself isn't shared.

items.question: Can I edit the site myself?
items.answer: Yes, you can change texts and photos **without a developer**. After launch I'll send you a **video guide** on how to manage your website.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: **One year of support is included:** technical updates and keeping the website running smoothly. Visual changes and new features aren't part of it and are quoted separately.
